focus: Chasing the fallout from Jensen Huang's Nvidia reinstatement while tracking major cloud and chip M&A moves.

priorities.why: Jensen Huang is officially back as Nvidia CEO, a massive industry development following intense political and board turmoil.
Amazon acquires Decart for $7.5B for AI optimization tech ahead of Trainium rollouts.
Anthropic's Claude Ship expands agent capabilities into automated GitHub pull request reviews and fixes.
Huang is scheduled to testify next week before the Senate regarding US export controls and his return.
